name: Blog Porter – Blog Migration Importer
author: Azor Studio

sections.description:
Blog Porter helps you move a public blog into WordPress without manually handling a large XML file. It imports posts, categories, tags, inline images, and featured images in small resumable batches, so an interrupted import can continue where it stopped.

Blog Porter supports migrations from Wix, Blogger, Medium, Squarespace, Webflow, and HubSpot when those platforms are enabled by the Blog Porter service. Medium exports can also be supplied as the ZIP archive provided by Medium. A Blog Porter migration is required before content can be imported.

External service and privacy

This plugin connects to the Blog Porter service at https://blogporter.com to analyze a blog, prepare a migration, process payment, and deliver migration content to WordPress. The remote service performs the source-platform analysis and conversion; the plugin only provides the WordPress administrator interface and imports the resulting migration content.

The plugin does not contact Blog Porter when an administrator merely opens its WordPress admin page. Before the first analysis, the administrator must confirm that they own the blog content and accept the Terms and Conditions. When an administrator explicitly analyzes a blog, starts checkout, connects an existing export, checks migration status, starts conversion, or imports content, the plugin sends only the information needed for that action. Depending on the action, this can include the selected source platform, source blog URL, export or migration ID, email address selected for export updates, WordPress site URL, plugin version, and a temporary connection token. For Medium, the administrator uploads the ZIP archive supplied by Medium; the archive is stored privately by Blog Porter so its posts can be converted. The plugin receives the selected migration content from Blog Porter and stores limited import progress and connection data in the WordPress installation.

Blog Porter is a paid, pay-as-you-go service and does not require an account. Payment is processed by Polar. Service terms and data handling details are available here:

  • Privacy Policy: https://blogporter.com/privacy
  • Terms and Conditions: https://blogporter.com/terms

Trademarks

WordPress is a trademark of the WordPress Foundation. Wix, Blogger, Medium, Squarespace, Webflow, HubSpot, and Polar are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective owners. Their names are used solely to identify supported services and do not imply endorsement or affiliation.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Blog Porter from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  3. Review the external-service and privacy information shown in the plugin.
  4. Analyze a supported public blog and complete checkout, or enter an existing Blog Porter export ID.
  5. Let Blog Porter check for existing posts, then start the import or choose whether existing posts should be updated.
sections.faq:
Do I need to upload an XML file?

No. The plugin downloads small batches directly from Blog Porter.

Does it copy images?

Yes. The initial version copies inline and featured images into the WordPress Media Library when the source server allows them to be downloaded.

Can I pause or retry an import?

Yes. Imports can be paused after the current post and resumed later. Posts or media with errors can be retried without duplicating successfully imported posts or attachments.
